QuestInfo.name: Sparkling Clean
QuestInfo.0: #b#p1092009##k the Pirate Maid needs your help. Something about dust and poor ventilation on the Nautilus. Whatever it is, it sounds important!
QuestInfo.1: Collect #bJellyfish Bodies#k for #b#p1092009#k to use for dusting.
QuestInfo.2: Mrs. Reade went back to dusting, leaving a thin sheen of jellyfish slime in her wake.

0.0: I hate dust! How does it get everywhere? Is it magic? Is it a curse? I don't know, but the blasted stuff never goes away for long!
0.1: Could you help me? \r\nI'm not going to ask you to clean, don't worry. I know you wouldn't accept.

yes.0: I've heard that the #b#o1220002#es#k in Low Wave Ocean are very sticky. Well, dust sticks to sticky things, so If I use a duster made from #r#t04000669##k, that should make my job easier, right?
yes.1: If you could bring me just 30 #b#tJellyfish Bodies##k, it would make a big difference. A BIG difference.

no.0: Really? You don't care if this place gets all filthy and dusty? Actually, from the look of you...maybe you don't...

1.0: Whoa! You're a quick one. You already brought 30?

yes.0: 1, 2, 3...30! Perfect! I don't know how to thank you. I tell you what...the next time you make a huge mess, I won't get super mad at you! But, just the next time, okay?

item.0: You still haven't brought the #b#tJellyfish Bodies##k? Jellyfish don't even fight back, do they?
